sources.title: DataMapper NGDPD 2026 API
sources.paraphrase: The requested API payload was unavailable through the web retrieval route. No France GDP value or independently recalculated ranking was extracted.

sources.title: DataMapper WEO dataset
sources.paraphrase: The retrieved page exposed interface placeholders rather than the country data table.

sources.title: World Economic Outlook October 2026 dataset
sources.paraphrase: The IMF dataset page identifies the October 2026 WEO release and describes annual country and aggregate data with projections. The nominal GDP ranking was not extracted.

sources.title: French Tech Next40/120 2026
sources.paraphrase: The 2026 programme selects 120 scaleups. Eligibility includes a French registered office, creation from 2006 and unlisted status at selection. Its named cohort is a bounded discovery source, not a national startup census.

sources.title: Actualisation du plan Deeptech
sources.paraphrase: The updated plan emphasizes research transfer, growth capital and industrial commercialization. Its EUR 30 billion financing requirement through 2030 is an ambition and need, not a measured amount already raised.

sources.title: Les entreprises tech françaises sont-elles présentes seulement à Paris ?
sources.paraphrase: The ministry reports more than 18,000 active startups for 2025, with 56% outside Île-de-France, and connects regional deeptech clusters with research institutions. These attributed national estimates are not an enumerated Atlas denominator.

sources.title: In-house Programs
sources.paraphrase: The Paris campus distinguishes F/ai, Fighters and Founders programmes from its Landing Zone. Retrieved programme entries show separate admissions, audiences and terms; a campus presence does not prove investment.

sources.title: French Tech 2030 promotion 2026
sources.paraphrase: The third cohort names 80 startups across AI, space, electronics, energy, robotics, quantum, health and cybersecurity. Cohort inclusion is programme evidence only.

sources.title: Labellisation 2026–2028 des Capitales et Communautés
sources.paraphrase: The 2026–2028 network lists 19 French Tech Capitals, 28 French communities and 78 international communities. Territorial associations support local coordination and internationalization; their members need individual identity review.

sources.title: Our support programmes
sources.paraphrase: IncubAlliance offers awareness, pre-incubation and incubation/acceleration in the Paris-Saclay ecosystem, covering health, digital deeptech, environmental technologies and space.

sources.title: Profil Entrepreneur
sources.paraphrase: Linksium supports pre-creation deeptech, founder-team formation and public-research technology transfer in the Grenoble area. Its support can include repayable advances; it is not automatically a priced equity round.

sources.title: Incubation and Acceleration explained
sources.paraphrase: EuraTechnologies distinguishes incubation in Lille or Roubaix from a year-long acceleration programme for revenue-generating startups based in Hauts-de-France.

sources.title: Incubation
sources.paraphrase: Connect by CNES directs space-related entrepreneurs to ESA BIC incubators with technical and business support. Incubation is distinct from an investment event.

sources.title: Programs
sources.paraphrase: Lyon's H7 offers acceleration and thematic programmes including digital inclusion, sustainable food and Web3, alongside a startup community.

sources.title: Filières et incubateurs
sources.paraphrase: Unitec's Bordeaux-area network includes digital, health and engineering incubation, Bordeaux Care Lab, energy/environmental transitions and wine-sector programmes.

sources.title: Deeptech Factory
sources.paraphrase: Deeptech Factory helps research-linked founders structure a venture before incorporation, within the Nantes Université and PREDICT innovation ecosystem.

sources.title: Entrepreneur
sources.paraphrase: France Angels describes a federation of regional and thematic angel networks and asks founders to choose the network appropriate to geography and sector. Network membership is not event participation.

sources.title: Qui sommes-nous ?
sources.paraphrase: France Digitale is an association connecting startups and venture investors, with entrepreneur and investor representation in its governance. Association membership does not imply a financing relationship.

sources.title: Qu'est-ce que France 2030 ?
sources.paraphrase: France 2030 is a EUR 54 billion investment plan covering companies, schools, universities and research bodies. Its envelope is not a startup-only venture-capital total or a company entitlement.

sources.title: French Tech Tremplin
sources.paraphrase: Tremplin supports entrepreneurs from underrepresented backgrounds; its fifth incubation cohort lists 102 companies, including overseas territories. The programme supplies a discovery route beyond prominent VC-backed firms.

sources.title: Concours d'innovation France 2030 2024–2025
sources.paraphrase: The 2024–2025 i-PhD, i-Lab and i-Nov cohorts represent research valorization, company creation and growth support operated by Bpifrance with ADEME. The historical cohorts are not current open-call eligibility.

sources.title: Annuaire des membres
sources.paraphrase: The public member index is visible, but detailed member profiles require purchased access. No paid profile, contact list or bulk directory was collected.

cohort.label: GDP 7/30 France
cohort.measure: Nominal GDP estimate, not final actual
cohort.reason: The requested DataMapper API returned a tool-disabled fetch; its WEO page exposed a dynamic shell. The official IMF data portal confirmed the October 2026 vintage but did not supply the ranking in the retrieved extract. Rank 7 is retained as the user's cohort label, not newly verified numeric evidence.
cohort.taiwan_convention: IMF separately reported economy convention, as supplied for the 30-economy cohort
